title: Input
description: What a host collects before invoking one of three operations (qc, upgrade, or author), through a question interface, command arguments, or another documented adapter mechanism.

targets.description: Workspace-relative targets to check; not needed for author, which starts from an outcome rather than existing files.

profile.description: 'core' or a profile id such as 'example-pipeline'.

checkpoint_path.description: The resumption point a run reads when the prepare half already wrote a checkpoint.

decision.description: Interview-supplied decision on what to do with findings or outcomes. For qc, one of the constants 'all', 'none', or an array of finding ids; for upgrade and author, either 'approve' or 'decline'. Defaults from gate-defaults.json.

stop_after_prepare.description: When true, the run stops after the prepare half, leaving the checkpoint for a later resume. When false (the default), the run continues into apply within the one orchestrator spawn.
